# routeros_interface_ppp_client (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Descriptive name of the interface.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `add_default_route` (Boolean) Whether to add the PPP remote address as a default route.
- `allow` (Set of String) Allowed authentication methods.
- `apn` (String) The Access Point Name used by the modem to establish the packet data connection.
- `comment` (String)
- `data_channel` (String) The modem channel that carries the PPP data connection.
- `default_route_distance` (Number) Distance value applied to the auto created default route, if add-default-route is selected.
- `dial_command` (String) The modem AT dial command used to establish the connection.
- `dial_on_demand` (Boolean) Dial out only when outbound traffic is generated.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `info_channel` (String) The modem channel used to query the modem status information.
- `keepalive_timeout` (String) Tunnel keepalive timeout in seconds.
- `max_mru` (Number) Maximum Receive Unit. Maximum packet size that the interface will be able to receive without packet fragmentation.
- `max_mtu` (Number) Maximum Transmission Unit. Maximum packet size that the interface will be able to send without packet fragmentation.
- `modem_init` (String) Modem initialization string sent before dialling.
- `mrru` (String) Maximum packet size that can be received on the link. If a packet is bigger than tunnel MTU, it will be split into multiple packets, allowing full size IP or Ethernet packets to be sent over the tunnel. Set to `disabled` to turn Multilink PPP off.
- `network_mode` (String) The cellular network mode the modem is allowed to use.
- `null_modem` (Boolean) Enables null-modem mode. When enabled, no modem initialization strings are sent and no dialling takes place.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password used for authentication.
- `phone` (String) Phone number used for dial out.
- `pin` (String, Sensitive) The PIN code of the SIM card.
- `port` (String) The serial port the modem is connected to, as listed by the `/port` menu.
- `profile` (String) Specifies which PPP profile configuration will be used when establishing the connection.
- `remote_address` (String) The IP address assigned to the remote end of the link.
- `use_peer_dns` (Boolean) Whether to use the DNS server settings advertised by the remote server.
- `user` (String) User name used for authentication.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `running` (Boolean)
